title: Understanding AL Development: String Conversion Management Code Unit
summary: The String Conversion Management Code Unit provides four procedures for handling text transformations in AL development, including encoding conversion, padding, decimal removal, and alphanumeric filtering. It wraps .NET System.Text objects functionality that would be difficult to implement in AL alone.
key_points: Contains four helper procedures: WindowsToASCII, GetPaddedString, RemoveDecimalFromString, and RemoveNonAlphaNumericCharacters
WindowsToASCII converts Windows encoding to ASCII with closest character equivalents
GetPaddedString adds padding to specified length with customizable character and justification
RemoveDecimalFromString filters non-numeric characters while preserving decimal points, then pads result
RemoveNonAlphaNumericCharacters uses regular expressions to strip special characters and underscores

quotes.text: This particular helper stems from the .NET System.Text objects.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the underlying foundation and capability of the code unit to perform operations difficult in pure AL

quotes.text: Don't dismiss it because of the smaller size, these procedures would be rather difficult to do in just AL.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the value of these helper procedures for text operations that are complex to implement manually
